arms.kind_s05: kind prior strength=0.5, frozen teacher snapshot (cache_ttl=1e9)
arms.seq_s00: sequence prior strength=0.0, frozen teacher snapshot (cache_ttl=1e9)
arms.seq_s05: sequence prior strength=0.5, frozen teacher snapshot (cache_ttl=1e9)

protocol.analysis: unpaired across arms (weighted rng consumes the RNG stream differently; v2-documented)
protocol.statistics: two-sided Fisher exact on pooled 2x2, alpha=0.05

rules_registered: R1': promising/harmful iff Fisher p<0.05 AND sign-consistent in >=3/4 scenarios (vs control)
R2': if seq_s00 (pure reshuffle) is detectable, seq_s05 bias verdicts are drawn vs seq_s00
R3': 'promising' only registers a follow-up experiment; defaults unchanged (prior stays opt-in/off)
R4': M7 PRIMARY comparison = seq_s05 vs kind_s05 head-to-head (same rule, same alpha)
R5': per-scenario deltas (incl. lru_cache_logic) are descriptive only — no per-scenario gate
